subject.why: Speaker post, twin speakers, red lamp, and background screen are present.

category.why: Ground features lumpy rocks instead of a simple clean strip.

clean.why: No text, UI elements, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The background screen unbalances the composition and the angle lacks heroic scale.

colour.why: Predominantly cool grey and desaturated; lacks overall warmth and juicy tones.

detail.why: Forms are chunky and simple without noisy micro-textures.

style.why: Smooth stylized volumes and satin finish align with reference cards.

fix: Warm up the overall color palette, flatten the ground into a simple strip, and adopt a lower camera angle centered on the speaker post.
